latest_publication.title: How to automate data entry between business systems
latest_publication.target_client_type: UK SMEs repeatedly copying customer, order, finance or operational fields between CRM, finance, ecommerce and workflow systems
latest_publication.industry_or_operating_context: Cross-system data entry, record matching, duplicate prevention, field ownership and exception routing
latest_publication.primary_buyer_problem: Teams repeatedly re-enter data that already exists in another system, creating delays, duplicate records, inconsistent values and repair work when systems drift apart.
latest_publication.primary_search_intent: Understand how to automate data entry between business systems without creating duplicate records, overwriting trusted values or hiding ambiguous matches.
latest_publication.trend_or_durable_demand: Durable SME operational demand. The topic targets a common cross-system hand-off problem rather than a short-lived trend.
latest_publication.evidence_source_and_date: Repository article library and overlap search checked 7 September 2026. A broader 'reduce manual data entry' angle was rejected because it would overlap existing spreadsheet and re-keying content; the selected intent is narrower and distinct.
latest_publication.existing_article_gap: The site covers wholesale order re-keying, CRM updates, management reporting and integration-versus-hand-off decisions, but not a broad cross-system data-entry workflow focused on source-of-truth ownership, stable identifiers, duplicate prevention and conflict handling.
